author: Laurie Pacelli
text: Excellent service! Everyone's very nice, honest, and informative. They were extremely thorough and efficient. Can't believe how fast everything was located, dug up, inspected, pumped out, and neatly covered back up. No lingering odor after either! I highly recommend them!

author: kate wuchter
text: We have been using Prince of Pools for years. They are fantastic and very professional in every way. You can't get any better then this company. They are simply the best in every thing they do. Thanks for taking great care of our septic. <3

author: Donna Luckey
text: Great service at a great price. The entire staff is friendly, courteous and knowledgeable.  Arrived early (confirmation before hand), answered my questions, and was very polite. Keith went above and beyond, will definitely be calling on them again.

author: quasardog
text:
Answered phone on first ring. Arrived in less than two hours.

author: Megan V.
text: Professional and quality service.  We were with another agency and happened to try Prince of Pools….that was 7 years ago!  We will never go anywhere else.
